# hl2modelib v1.0.9 — Source 2013 materials / T-103 validation

## What the uploaded Source 2013 SDK says

Reference points in the supplied `source-sdk-2013-master.zip`:
- `src/materialsystem/stdshaders/vertexlitgeneric_dx9_helper.cpp`: `$bumpmap` is a defined/conditional resource, not a mandatory effect. The renderer needs tangent-space data when bump mapping is enabled. The SDK has important constraints on environment masks and bump maps.
- `src/materialsystem/stdshaders/vertexlitgeneric_dx9.cpp` and related `VertexLitGeneric` pixel shader files: shader permutations are selected from the material settings and hardware path.
- `src/materialsystem/stdshaders/lightmappedgeneric_dx9_helper.cpp`: lightmapped world surfaces follow another material path, not the same vertex-lit route as a skeletal character.

Our code is an independent fixed-point **software approximation**, not a port or binary-compatible GPU shader implementation.

## Actual T-103 corpus (t103.zip)

| Model | Relevant material settings | Native textures |
|---|---|---|
| `tyrant` phases 1–3 | VertexLitGeneric; `$bumpmap` in phases 1–2 is commented out; wear includes `$nocull` | Albedo VTF only |
| `tyrant01` | VertexLitGeneric, `$bumpmap`, `$alphatest 1`, `$nocull 1` | 4 matching base textures and 4 RGB normal maps VTF (DXT5/BC3) |
| `tyrant01/xlegend` | VertexLitGeneric, `$alphatest` | Albedo VTF |

The corpus material VMTs **do not enable** `$phong`, `$rimlight`, `$detail`, or `$envmap`. These remain opt-in in the library and must **not** be applied to T-103 by default. The four `_n.vtf` files are genuine RGB normals (blue values vary near 255, alpha is 255), **not** DXT5nm swizzled XY maps: keep `normal_dxt5nm=0`.

## v1.0.9 renderer-neutral path

```
master_decode89(MDL/VVD/VTX) --> master_mesh89 --> vertices/UV/normal/tangent.w
master_material89(VMT) --> material flags and VTF paths
master_texture89(VTF) --> caller-owned RGBA8 buffers
material_vtf_path89() --> lower-case forward-slash .vtf paths
        |              |
        +---------- fragment89 <-- UV + tangent basis + sampled normal VTF
                         |
                     master_shade89 --> RGBA8 lit fragment
```

The new bridge `hl2m_master_fragment89()` sets up the tangent basis and samples base/normal/detail maps; `hl2m_master_shade89()` computes a lit color. The painter/presenter is responsible for rasterization, skinning pose, camera, and light directions. Visibility from an actual shadow map is passed through `frag.have_shadow` + `frag.shadow_factor`, **not** generated by this codec.

The tangent handedness uses VVD `tangent.w`, and RGB/DXT5nm normal maps are decoded differently. Bump-space normals are normalized before dot products. Additional fragment support includes `$halflambert` and a supplied direct-light visibility mask.

### Example

```c
/* Populate fg with ambient/light/view direction values first. */
hl2m_master_fragment89(&fg, &fx,
    engine.vertices[i].normal, engine.vertices[i].tangent,
    &base_view, &bump_view, 0,
    engine.vertices[i].texcoord.x, engine.vertices[i].texcoord.y);
hl2m_master_shade89(&fx, &fg, rgba);
```

`engine.vertices[i].material` selects the VMT/VTF bundle for each material; material path resolution is up to the host asset layer. The presenter should interpolate normal, tangent, UV and shading data across **fragments**, not rely only on per-vertex colors.

## Verified real-corpus tests

- `tyrant01.mdl` version 49, VVD/VTX: **7,513 triangles**, **22,539 engine draw vertices**, **5 materials**.
- Four VMT-linked normal maps decoded as DXT5 and bound to shader inputs; the fifth material has no normal map.
- **11,061 vertex-color samples** changed with normal mapping enabled; same mesh, UVs and light conditions.
- C89 offline swatch: `ety1_head.vmt`, `ety1_head.vtf`, `ety1_head_n.vtf`, both **512×512**, passes.
- Strict C89 compile / `make check` and `make check-material109` pass.

Preview PLYs are generated with *per-vertex* shading to make regression inexpensive and reproducible. OpenCV/Python is used **only to display** those C89-computed colors and meshes. A reference-matching per-pixel GPU renderer remains to be implemented.

## Not implemented / not claimed

- Exact DX9 Source 2013 shader permutations, lighting model, gamma/color-space transforms or cubemap reflections.
- True stencil/depth/cascaded shadow-map creation, volumetric shadows, self-shadowing or dynamic lighting dispatch from the renderer.
- GPU bilinear/trilinear/anisotropic filtered texturing and full mip/LOD state.
- Full per-fragment lightmaps for `LightmappedGeneric`; that is primarily a BSP world-surface concern, not skeletal T-103 data.
- Exact Valve runtime alpha blending and transparency sorting.
- Native `phongexponenttexture`, diffuse warp and environment-map masks are not bound to real texture resources by this patch.

Those are implementation gaps, **not additional textures hidden in the T-103 archive**. We must not fabricate unsupported material resources.

## Compatibility

- All v1.0.8 codec readers, animations, mesh, physics/IK and format vendors remain present.
- No heap, no `float`, no `double`, no 64-bit integer arithmetic in the new C code.
- Source/header ABI is now 0x0109 because `hl2m_material_fx89` and `hl2m_fragment89` gained fields. **Recompile all dependent engines**.
